summary: The South Hadley Public Library relies on E-Rate funding to provide internet access to its community, which is essential for student learning, job searching, health care, and other services. The library argues that E-Rate funding is crucial for maintaining access to the internet for all residents, especially those in rural areas who may not have other access. claims.argument: Limiting funding could reduce access to internet services for schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: Our location in Western Massachusetts can sometimes place us at a geographic disadvantage with our more populous and affluent neighbors closer to Boston. Citizens using the library computers often do not have other access to the internet. E-Rate funding levels the playing field for all residents and needs to remain fully funded
